item.title: How Does DESeq2 Perform Normalization?
item.description:
Differential gene expression (DGE) analysis requires correcting for two major sources of technical variation:

  1. Library size differences (sequencing depth)
  2. Compositional bias between samples

Why gene length normalization is not needed

Gene length normalization (like normalization methods in RPKM or TPM) is not required for DGE analysis because:

  • DGE compares the same gene across conditions, not different genes within a sample and the same gene has the same length in different samples.

What is compositional bias and why does it matter?

Compositional bias occurs when a subset of genes is highly expressed in one condition or tissue but not in others.
